# OpenSMS API for LLMs & AI Agents

> OpenSMS is an open-source, privacy-first Android application that turns an Android device into a high-performance cellular SMS Gateway REST API server. Supports local Wi-Fi, Tailscale WireGuard Mesh, Dual-SIM routing, and SQLite WAL persistence.

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Cellular SMS Dispatch**: Sends real SMS messages over native cellular modems via standard HTTP REST requests.
- **Cross-Network Connectivity**: Reaches devices across cellular CGNAT, home Wi-Fi, or cloud VPCs using zero-config Tailscale WireGuard Mesh (`100.x.y.z`).
- **Dual-SIM Telephony**: Routes messages via specific carrier slots (`sim_slot: 0` or `1`) or system auto-selection.
- **Message Lifecycle Tracking**: Persistent delivery tracking (`queued`, `sending`, `sent`, `failed`) backed by SQLite WAL mode.
- **Batch Processing**: Up to 100 SMS messages per call with 100ms hardware pacing.
- **Security**: SHA-256 Bearer Token authentication with brute-force rate-limiting.

## Standard Endpoint Quick Reference
Base URL: `http://<DEVICE_IP>:9292` (Port default: 9292)
Authorization Header: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`

| Endpoint | Method | Description | Auth Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/health/` | GET | Gateway liveness probe | No |
| `/sms/` | POST | Send single SMS | Yes |
| `/sms/batch/` | POST | Send batch SMS (max 100) | Yes |
| `/sms/{id}` | GET | Get SMS delivery status | Yes |
| `/sms/history/` | GET | List historical messages | Yes |
| `/system/stats/` | GET | Sent today, success rate, queue | Yes |
| `/system/sims/` | GET | Active SIM slots & carriers | Yes |
| `/system/update/`| GET | Check for GitHub updates | Yes |
| `/llms.txt` | GET | This discovery file | No |

## Rules for AI Code Generation
1. Always format phone numbers with standard international E.164 notation (e.g., `+1234567890`) or national digits. The gateway automatically strips spaces, hyphens, and brackets.
2. Standard SMS segment size is 160 characters for GSM-7 plain text, and 70 characters when Unicode/emojis are present (UCS-2). The API handles segmentation automatically via Android native multipart SMS.
3. Handle HTTP 401 (invalid/missing token), HTTP 429 (rate-limited after 5 failed auth attempts; wait 60s), and HTTP 500 (carrier transmission failure).
